name: skills-plus-plus
description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills plus a spec-driven delivery pipeline on GitHub Issues: grilling, spec and ticket flows, parallel worktree builds, gated review, TDD, domain modelling and more.

interface.shortDescription: Matt Pocock's engineering skills plus an issue-native SDD pipeline.
interface.longDescription: The engineering flow (grill, spec, tickets, TDD, code review, domain modelling) plus the SDD pipeline on GitHub Issues: to-tickets hardens sub-issues with Files owned, Interfaces, Test scenarios and Verify; build-epic dispatches isolated workers in waves and gates each PR with a fresh reviewer; review-panel gates the PR to main; close-epic writes the retro. Codex has no custom-agent slot, so workers are plain subagent delegations. Codex receives every bucket under skills/, including in-progress and misc.
